topics.topic: Start operation, ordering, and refusal for installation configuration validation
questions: Which start-time configuration checks belong to `load_installation`, including unique agent names and credential-header syntax?
Which start operation validates every configured credential header as an HTTP field-name token, in what order relative to the other configuration checks, and what refusal reason does it return?
Which start operation validates that every configured credential header name is an HTTP field-name token, and where does that check fall in start-error order?

judgement.divergence: One implementer makes `installation.load_installation` reject duplicate agent names and syntactically invalid credential-header names in a chosen order; another leaves one or both checks to another start step or omits them, so the host notices different startup success, first-failure reason, or ordering when several configuration faults coexist.
judgement.why: The texts require both startup checks but do not assign all of them to a public operation or order them with the other configuration checks.

topics.topic: Owner operation for reading trial-case file-fixture bytes
questions: Can the owner read the bytes of a trial-case file fixture, and if so through which operation?
Can the owner inspect the bytes of a trial-case file fixture, and if so through which public operation and with what inputs and output limit?

quotes: a file — StoredValue fixture or SpooledFile — as digest, size and media type, its bytes only through `read_spooled_file`.
`read_spooled_file` takes only a SpooledFile — never a StoredValue — and names it by its identity
judgement.why: The owner is promised every value, but trial fixtures are StoredValues whose bytes cannot be requested through the only byte-reading surface operation.

topics.topic: Snapshot, live-filter, and cursor-validity semantics for filtered pagination
questions: If records enter or leave a status filter between pages, is paging a snapshot of first-page membership or a live re-evaluation, and is a token still valid if its anchor record no longer matches the filter?
If the cursor record changes status and no longer matches the filter between pages, does the token remain valid, and are later pages a live view or a snapshot of membership at the first page?

judgement.divergence: One implementer snapshots first-page filter membership and keeps the cursor valid after its anchor changes status; another re-evaluates the filter live and either rejects that cursor or changes which later records appear, which the paging caller notices as different pages or an `invalid_request`.
judgement.why: The texts stabilize additions and bind tokens to filters but do not define membership or anchor validity when lifecycle fields change in place.

topics.topic: Source of the schema for flow constants
questions: Where does a constant's `value_schema` come from?
Must each constant submission declare its own `value_schema`, or is that schema derived from its target port or another source?

quotes: A constant's StoredValue takes the `value_schema` and class the composing agent declared with it (State 6, decision 5), never its target's, so a version whose constant targets a missing or unfitting port is still kept and fails its proof (A05 phases 2 and 3).
judgement.why: The passage expressly says the composing agent declares the constant's schema and that it is not derived from the target port.

topics.topic: Allowed encoding and normalization of HTTP and credential header values
questions: Which character repertoire and byte encoding are allowed for required-header and credential values, and what happens to non-ASCII or leading/trailing-whitespace credential values that an HTTP library cannot send verbatim?

topics.topic: Allowed service base-URL components and URL and Host-header construction
questions: May `api_base_url` contain user information, a non-root path, query, fragment, percent escapes or an IPv6 zone identifier, and exactly how are those components combined with the operation path and used for the `host` header?

topics.topic: Applicability of the not_applied resend exception to standing grants
questions: Is the grant operation's observable-effect statement subject to the `not_applied` resend exception for every effect class?

topics.topic: Attempt used to determine an operation element's current conclusion
questions: Which attempt determines the current conclusion when an operation element has multiple attempts?

topics.topic: Byte representation used to measure JSON value size limits
questions: Are JSON value size limits measured using received request bytes, UTF-8 noncanonical serialization, or RFC 8785 canonical bytes?

topics.topic: Closed failure reasons and fields for each flow-proof phase
questions: What exact reason identifiers and accompanying fields can a ProofResult failure return for each check in the nine proof phases?

topics.topic: Closed identifiers allowed as refusal reasons
questions: What exact, closed identifiers may appear in the `reason` for each `refused` result, rather than implementation-chosen prose or check names?

topics.topic: Completeness of models returned by inspection read operations
questions: Do `read_contract_version`, `read_implementation`, `read_binding`, `read_flow_version` and the MCP getters return the complete stored models including identities, provenance and timestamps, or only the fields individually listed by each operation?

topics.topic: Duplicate agent-name behavior during live token-list re-read
questions: When the live token-list re-read introduces two agents with the same name but different tokens, must the re-read fail, or may both tokens produce the same Actor identity?

topics.topic: Exact Content-Type sent for JSON request bodies
questions: What exact `Content-Type` header value is sent for POST, PUT or PATCH JSON bodies and therefore included in the approval request description?

topics.topic: Immutable resolution semantics for manifest location and revision
questions: What operation resolves `manifest_location` and `manifest_revision` to immutable bytes, including what kind of location and revision they are and whether working-tree changes at the same revision are visible?

topics.topic: Input representation and parsing ownership for canonical JSON bytes
questions: Does `canonical_bytes` receive raw JSON text or a lossless parsed representation when duplicate-member detection is required, and which layer owns parsing?

topics.topic: Meaning and domain-specific distinctions of content_identity results
questions: When given a runtime JSON value, does this operation return the raw `value_digest`, the StoredValue `value_id` derived from digest/schema/carriage/media type/class, or either according to an unstated mode; and how are request digests, corpus digests, manifest record digests and idempotency keys distinguished?

topics.topic: Meaning of execution timestamps when no execution or send occurs
questions: What do `started_at` and `ended_at` mean for `operation_failed` before send, `refused_by_owner`, `skipped_by_guard`, `upstream_failed`, a mapped node over an empty list, and a receiving-node contract violation, where no execution or send begins?

topics.topic: Mutable Run fields and storage of outputs, waits, and resumptions
questions: Which Run fields may be updated after `start_run`, and are outputs, waiting points and resumptions fields of the Run record or separate records?

topics.topic: Ordering restrictions on rollback targets
questions: May rollback activate any qualifying non-current implementation, including one activated later than the current implementation, or only an implementation earlier in submission or activation order?

topics.topic: Persistence and attribution of Actor information on record changes
questions: Where and how is the supplied Actor persisted or otherwise used for records without a model-specific actor field, and which actor is attached when one call writes both caller-authored and kernel-authored records?

topics.topic: Representation and authorization of successful try_implementation outputs
questions: Does a try response expose successful value outputs as resolved JSON values, only their digests, or both, and does the answer differ for owner and agent beyond the personal-data masking rule?

topics.topic: Representation and storage of file fixtures supplied to add_trial_case
questions: How are authored input and expected-output file fixtures supplied to `functions.add_trial_case`: raw bytes, a byte stream, or digest/size/media-type facts referencing bytes already stored somewhere?

topics.topic: Safe encoding and credential redaction of service failure_detail
questions: How must `send_prepared_request` encode arbitrary response bytes and guarantee that a service which echoes the credential cannot place it in `failure_detail`?

topics.topic: Schema stored for many-valued StoredValues
questions: Does a StoredValue containing a `many` value store the port's element schema or a synthesized array schema, and must that rule apply in every producer?

topics.topic: Store initialization behavior when opening a missing or empty store
questions: Does `open_store` initialize a new empty store, require a pre-created empty private directory, or refuse every missing component?

topics.topic: Supported-schema validation scope and failure stage for bindings and flows
questions: Which ports and constant schemas must be in the supported schema subset, and does an unsupported schema cause proposal/composition refusal or a proof failure?

topics.topic: Validation and ownership of configured service identifiers before path construction
questions: Must configured service identifiers be validated before `bindings.check_installed_instances` constructs manifest paths, and which operation owns that refusal?

topics.topic: Validation precedence in capture_failed_execution
questions: Before checking whether the execution is capturable and whether its run holds the spool, must the operation resolve the separately named contract version and return `unknown_reference` if it is missing, or are record/run refusals allowed to win first?

topics.topic: Validity and rejection stage of file-carriage or many path-placeholder ports
questions: Are file-carriage or `many` ports with string/integer schemas valid path placeholders, and if not, must the binding be refused at proposal rather than every send ending `input_not_placeable`?

topics.topic: Whether refusal reasons may be truncated
questions: May refusal reasons be truncated, or must every reason be constructed within the ceiling without truncation?

topics.topic: Whether run continuation after retry or approval guarantees a wire send
questions: Does resume guarantee a wire send for every `service_unreachable` element, or only reach each element again so that it may send, wait for approval, or fail a pre-send check?

What exact successful outcomes may follow approval: must a request reach the wire, or may the operation return a run that failed a pre-send check or is awaiting a replacement approval without sending?

topics.topic: Whether trial-case expected outputs must cover every contract output
questions: When `expected_outputs` is present, must it contain exactly every contract output, or may it assert only a subset?
